title: Inversion Thinking
prompt:
Act as a strategic risk advisor using inversion thinking.
Goal        :   [WHAT I AM TRYING TO ACHIEVE  be specific]
Context  :   [SITUATION, INDUSTRY, STAGE, TEAM]
Step 1      :   List everything that would guarantee I fail. Think broadly - execution,  
                     market, team,  timing, assumptions, behaviour.
Step 2     :   Rank these failure causes by probability.
Step 3     :   For the top 5, give one specific prevention action I can take 
                    before moving forward.
